description: A ListActivity subclass demonstrating displaying contacts with phone numbers from the device's contacts database, using a cursor and SimpleCursorAdapter.

classes.name: List7
classes.description: An activity that displays a list of contacts with phone numbers, allowing selection to show the number details.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, creates a cursor for contacts with phone numbers, and sets up the list adapter.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles list item selection, retrieves contact info from cursor, determines phone type, and updates TextView.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Callback for when no list item is selected; does nothing.
